scope: Existing proposal and frozen remaining work; no added question/data acquisition

items.work: Retained sources, exact mappings, native coverage and threshold/season support
items.interpretation_limit: Fixed 2025 weights and short reference; exact identifiers only. Annual coverage is not positive-baseline or event-window qualification.

items.work: Connection references, missing/zero values and uncertain STOP/cyclone/synchronous screening
items.interpretation_limit: Candidates are not confirmed faults. Unknown shutdown ends remain unknown; hypothetical masks are sensitivities. Historical final_sample_review_not_completed flags are preserved, not rewritten as fault approvals.

items.work: Matched curves, common-event/control support, lead and covariance diagnostics
items.interpretation_limit: Primary signed day-zero intervals include zero; this is not equivalence or causal identification. Common matched dose sample lacks residual df. Shared-date/non-PSD diagnostics remain disclosed.

items.work: A/B, M1/M2 five-outcome dose projections and inference
items.interpretation_limit: Fractional projections sometimes cross bounds; original coefficients are retained as linear conditional differences, not probabilities. Original 230-case adjustment is retrospective.

items.work: Limited M3 HD×NTRD and separate HD×dewpoint completion
items.interpretation_limit: Previously omitted requirement completed after primary results viewed. Thirty within-family tests, twenty estimates, ten unavailable; AP maintenance interaction passes BH/BY but model-boundary/selection/inference limitations remain. No study-wide FDR or mechanism identification.

items.work: Full-window DHRD, phased duration, core/full peaks, all states and conditional recovery
items.interpretation_limit: All events and damaged-at-end risk sets have separate denominators. BGP has no recovery endpoints; AP is sparse. PH/independent censoring and causal recovery are not certified.

items.work: Six predefined social/stability modifiers, source years and DLEP
items.interpretation_limit: Thirty of fifty-four interaction cases estimated; no BH/BY rejection. Group overlap is marginal. Strictly prior capability years differ from current-or-prior DLEP; DLEP is not disconnected people.

items.work: Comparable-load geographic comparisons
items.interpretation_limit: All 126 comparisons retained; three mathematical estimates but zero qualified displays after disclosed post-hoc information guard. No global ranking or silently zeroed unsupported effect.

items.work: Heat definitions, omitted reference years, alternative baseline/masks, country/region deletion, recovery definitions
items.interpretation_limit: All directions/unavailable cases retained. Changed samples are not paired causal contrasts; deletion ranges are not confidence intervals; numerical-health rules are post-hoc.

items.work: Nonheat pseudo-events and sequence-preserving calendar translations
items.interpretation_limit: Original-control pseudo-anchors and sparse observed-date blocks; not a calibrated random-permutation null. Nonnull placebo slices remain reported.

items.work: Audited population-supported daily precipitation before/after adjustment
items.interpretation_limit: Supported daily subset only; primary ten-minute/dose/recovery results remain unadjusted. Missing supported population is not moved or filled zero.

items.work: Country mean-solar clock and pixel-local Q90 weather diagnostics
items.interpretation_limit: Country circular-mean and pixel-specific clocks are distinct. Maps describe local weather pressure, not equipment/fault footprints or solar-day network effects.

items.work: Seven-other-year target-omitted reference
items.interpretation_limit: 2022–24 references contain later observations; no alternative network effect, long-normal uncertainty or prospective prediction is certified.

items.work: Existing ADM1 support assessment
items.interpretation_limit: 226 regions, no approved geometry links. No ADM1 exposure/effect claim. Proposal makes reliable ADM1 analysis conditional; no guessed mappings.

items.work: Old temperature common-month agreement and four-month wind paired comparison
items.interpretation_limit: Old-product January/February/March/July 2024 only, not a full alternative reference. Wind AP3/BGP4 groups, native reassignment certification incomplete: exploratory comparison only, not verified full-period wind control. No new downloads.

items.work: CMIP6 independent appendix
items.interpretation_limit: Explicitly conditional in proposal; not required to support historical connectivity claims. No future connectivity-loss forecast or newly certified CMIP6 result is delivered.

items.work: Focused literature update and source editions
items.interpretation_limit: Primary articles/data sources checked; fifteen references resolve. No first-ever or exhaustive systematic-review claim; preprint remains identified as such.

items.work: Integrated manuscript, four main tables, S1–S3 and editable five-figure set
items.interpretation_limit: 44 manuscript /19 supplementary pages. Five figures are supplied as PNG/PDF/SVG; statistical and source-support limits remain substantive, not erased by layout acceptance.

items.work: Interactive historical replay and explicit fallback
items.interpretation_limit: Nine Node/minimal-DOM tests, not real-browser usability. Local offline HTML fallback is the authorized delivery mode; no verified public URL, future risk probability or operational fault service is claimed.

items.work: Reproduction, immutable provenance and deadline disclosure
items.interpretation_limit: Current source-status metadata included. Raw-global observational pipeline not newly repeated; scientific and browser limitations above remain.

scientific_disposition: Observational, measurement/support limited; revise/no-go for causal heat-failure, global-ranking and predictive-service claims
acceptance_meaning: Research-material completeness and reproducible disclosed analysis; NOT acceptance of causal heat-failure, global-ranking, forecast or public-service claims.
